# hpe_morpheus_network_router_bgp_neighbor (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the network router this BGP neighbor belongs to

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the BGP neighbor
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address of the BGP neighbor. Used to look up the neighbor if ID is not provided.

### Read-Only

- `allow_as_in` (Boolean)
- `bfd_enabled` (Boolean)
- `bfd_interval` (Number)
- `bfd_multiple` (Number)
- `config` (Dynamic) Generic BGP neighbor configuration object. Settings vary by router type.
- `config_nsxt` (Attributes) Configuration for NSX-T Tier-0/Tier-1 router BGP neighbors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nsxt))
- `config_nsxv` (Attributes) Configuration for NSX-V Edge router BGP neighbors (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config_nsxv))
- `date_created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `external_id` (String)
- `forwarding_address` (String)
- `hold_down` (Number)
- `hop_limit` (Number)
- `internal_id` (String)
- `keep_alive` (Number)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `protocol_address` (String)
- `provider_id` (String)
- `ref_id` (Number)
- `ref_type` (String)
- `remote_as` (String)
- `restart_mode` (String)
- `route_filtering_in` (String)
- `route_filtering_out` (String)
- `route_filtering_type` (String)
- `sync_source` (String)
- `weight` (Number)

Read-Only:

- `source_addresses` (Set of String) Source IP addresses for the BGP session
